scope: Opt-in bounded native ESP settings worker binding for two explicitly registered namespaces; no product enablement
host_components: Actual ESP worker TU, NativeSettingsCoordinator, CheckedNativeReplicaStore, AppDataFiles, NvsReplicaMetadata; only RTOS/heap/shared-resource and NVS SDK/space accounting are host shims.
identity_checks: Explicit/Core/store namespace agreement and actual bound backend context plus every callback; duplicate/reused objects, ISR and foreign task rejected.
legacy_behavior: No-argument lookups work only with exactly one binding; two registrations fail closed. Same owner task required for both; aggregate exit checks both.
global_io_serialization: Both coordinators use unchanged nativeBackgroundResourceTry/End hooks; owner lease remains held through terminal collection or sticky Retained.

target.result: PASS translation unit/API/layout probes; default-off TU empty; no task-delete, LittleFS mount or NVS-init dependency
budget_exclusions: caller-owned permanent Core/store/metadata/native-client controls and dependencies

limits: Not a firmware link or target execution
No physical SD, power-cut, RAM high-water or timing qualification
No private mount provisioning, product/Watch policy, LittleFS qualification, source publication or firmware delivery
Host scheduler stops only after native calls return, never force-deletes a blocked task
